description: Station-level spec for the four demo objects. Per-object geometry lives in each object's config JSON (the editable source of dimensions).
user_corrections: Blue_Bucket_01 outer diameter is 139 mm constant (old 115 mm is wrong)
Green_Ring_02 through-hole is 78 mm (old 88 mm is wrong)

robodk.frame_pose_note: DISPLAY-ONLY layout. Applied only when Objects_Frame is first created (an existing frame is never moved unless --reset-frame-pose). With rz=90 the row of objects runs along the robot base Y axis at X=-620 mm, beside the demo table's cube/pad. Does NOT prove free space in the real cell.

pose_convention: display_pose_mm_deg = [x, y, z, rx, ry, rz] in Objects_Frame; pose = transl(x,y,z) * rotz(rz) * roty(ry) * rotx(rx)
